text.short: Bakersfield, 1893–2020, then 2021–2025. Closed twice. The bar and the neon sign are in a museum.
text.today: Nothing serves under this name. The Sumner Street building stands empty.
text.history: One seating, one bell, one price, whatever the kitchen cooked that day, at a table you shared. The James Beard Foundation named it an America's Classic in 2011. It closed in 2020. New owners reopened a Noriega's on Stockdale Highway in June 2021 with the old recipes and the old chairs; that closed in early 2025. The bar and the neon went to the Kern County Museum.

status.note: Closed at Sumner Street in 2020; the Stockdale Highway room closed in early 2025.

seating.note: One bell, one seating, strangers down the length of the table. Recorded as it was.
